candidates.change_summary: Return the zero address instead of the stored owner.
Return msg.sender instead of the stored owner.
Remove the _checkOwner() call from onlyOwner so any caller can invoke transferOwnership, allowing a non-owner to change the owner.
Remove the `_ ;` continuation so functions guarded by onlyOwner never execute their body and ownership is never transferred.
Remove the zero-address check so transferOwnership can set the owner to address(0).
Transfer ownership to address(0) instead of newOwner, so owner() returns the zero address after the call.
Invert the require condition so transferOwnership reverts for any non-zero newOwner, blocking all successful ownership transfers.
Delete the _transferOwnership call so the owner never changes even when transferOwnership succeeds.
Delete the assignment to rewardDistributor so the state variable keeps its old value while the event still fires.
Assign msg.sender instead of the _distributor parameter to rewardDistributor.
Remove the _checkOwner() call from the onlyOwner modifier so any caller can change rewardDistributor.
